items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; AI-cost records require reconciliation, with the current snapshot reporting $886.12 across 4,865 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27; and infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are incomplete. The minimum measurement is period-aligned attributable revenue by tracking ID and site/content, one reconciled AI-cost ledger, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs, approved budgets, experiment costs, and a defined learning outcome with a cost-to-learn threshold. Treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, performance scores, and AI usage as operating or learning signals—not financial returns. Continue only existing repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Retain site and CRO opportunities as deferred backlog; do not create duplicate work. Keep private launch gates and unsent external outreach unchanged.
